title: Upgrade tonic 0.12 -> 0.14 and prost 0.13 -> 0.14
description:
Coupled: tonic, tonic-build and prost/prost-types must move together or codegen breaks.

Largest surface. Regenerates the SPIFFE Workload API bindings from proto/spiffe/workload/workload.proto via persona-grpc/build.rs. Note persona-5s4b.17 (build.rs emits no rerun-if-changed) means stale generated code may mask or confuse results - force a clean rebuild. Also watch persona-5s4b.35: serve() returns a non-Send Box<dyn Error> that may change shape across the tonic major.
close_reason: tonic 0.14.6 + prost 0.14.4 upgraded. Required migrating build.rs to tonic-prost-build (prost codegen split out of tonic-build in 0.14) and adding tonic-prost. Dropped now-unused tonic-build. Tests 37/37 including e2e. Also collapsed the duplicate tower 0.4.
